/**
 * Dedicated Dictionary Search Structure bucket log. In the
 * ZSTD_dedicatedDictSearch mode, the hashTable has
 * 2 ** ZSTD_LAZY_DDSS_BUCKET_LOG entries in each bucket, rather than just

 */
